statement: A program sets x to 0 and y to any whole number of at least 0, and while x < 99 adds 2 to x when y is even and 1 when y is odd. SV-COMP's task loop-acceleration/diamond_1-1 asserts afterwards that x % 2 equals y % 2. Define a function of an assertion, a predicate on a state {"x", "y"}, that gives true when every run that leaves the loop meets it, for every y, and false otherwise. The program's value is the function.
